subject_definitions:
<Subject 1> is Cloud Strife from <Picture 1>, with spiky pale-blond hair, turquoise eyes, black sleeveless turtleneck, black leather left-shoulder pauldron, brown leather suspenders and belt, black baggy pants, brown boots, and the massive black-and-silver Buster Sword; his superpower is dashing into a blue-glowing afterimage and chaining rapid slash duplicates.
<Subject 2> is Sephiroth from <Picture 2>, with extremely long straight silver hair, narrow cold eyes, long black leather coat with white shoulder pauldrons, crossed black chest harness, black gloves, black boots, and the long noduchi Masamune; his superpower is manipulating tangible black miasma that forms both defensive shields and long-range slicing tendrils.
<Subject 3> is the shared battlefield environment: a cracked dark-stone plateau under roiling purple-grey storm clouds, wind-blown ash and debris.

summary:
[reference generation] The target video is a continuous superhuman duel between <Subject 1> and <Subject 2> on <Subject 3>: Cloud dashes into blue afterimages and chains phantom slashes, Sephiroth deflects with swirling black miasma shields and counterfires black tendrils, all in chained medium close-ups with sub-one-second impact inserts. No wide shots, no slow motion.

retention_analysis:
<Subject 1> (appears throughout): fully_preserved - Cloud's spiky blond hair, outfit, pauldron, and Buster Sword are retained; the blue-afterimage dash is his superpower.
<Subject 2> (appears throughout): fully_preserved - Sephiroth's long silver hair, black leather coat, pauldrons, and Masamune are retained; the black miasma is his superpower.
<Subject 3> (appears throughout): partially_preserved - the cracked stone ground, ash, and stormy atmosphere are retained; no wide establishing shot.

detailed_description:
The target video uses a high-end 3D game-cutscene combat style with harsh key lighting, glowing blue afterimage trails, and swirling black miasma particles. Shots are chained medium close-ups at chest-to-waist level following the fighters' bodies; macro inserts last no longer than 1.0 second each. No slow motion.
[Shot 1] Medium close-up: <Subject 1> dashes straight in, body dissolving into a trailing blue light afterimage, and appears three times in a row from different angles—slashing high, low, and crosswise with the Buster Sword. <Subject 2> raises a swirling wall of black miasma in front of himself; each blue slash detonates against the black shield in bursts of blue and black sparks.
[Shot 2] At 00:03.500, sub-1.0s macro insert: a blue phantom blade-edge slicing through a sheet of black miasma, black ink-like vapor bursting sideways. Cut straight back.
[Shot 3] At 00:04.200, medium close-up: <Subject 2> sweeps his hand sideways and launches three whip-like black miasma tendrils snaking through the air toward Cloud. <Subject 1> blinks into blue afterimages, dodging two by inches, and raises the Buster Sword to slice the third in half; the severed tendril hisses into black smoke on the stone.
[Shot 4] At 00:07.500, sub-1.0s macro insert: <Subject 1>'s boot pushing off the stone, blue light coiling up around his ankle. Cut straight back.
[Shot 5] At 00:08.200, medium close-up: <Subject 1> reappears directly behind <Subject 2> in a blue afterimage and throws a heavy Buster Sword backslash; Sephiroth spins and catches it on Masamune, while a black miasma shield flares up from his other side to block a second phantom slash from Cloud's left. The two powers grind against each other in a burst of blue and black light. Both fighters skid apart one meter and immediately surge back, blades and powers locking again.

overall_soundscape:
Continuous howling wind, the sharp whoosh of blue-afterimage dashes, wet tearing slaps of black miasma tendrils, sustained metallic screech of steel-on-steel, detonating bursts of blue-and-black energy on each clash, stone cracking underfoot, and leather snapping.
